description:
• About our brand and products:

Beauty Scents Ltd is a family-run, Peterborough (UK) based candle studio making handcrafted soy candles and wax melts. Our products are vegan-friendly and decorated with real botanicals for a rustic, country-style look that’s perfect for gifting. Every design is handmade in small batches and tested for safe, clean burning.


• What makes us different:

  • Handmade in the UK: Artisan-crafted, not mass-produced.
  • Vegan-friendly soy wax: Plant-based wax and carefully selected fragrance oils.
  • Real botanicals: Natural decorative elements that make each candle feel special.
  • Gift-ready aesthetic: Rustic, thoughtful, “send as a gift” appeal.
  • Proven bestsellers: Customer favourites include Champagne & Roses, Raspberry, and Lavender.

How affiliates can earn:

  • 15% commission on all tracked referral sales.
  • 30-day cookie period: if a customer purchases within 30 days of clicking your link, you’ll earn commission (subject to programme rules).
  • Weekly commission payouts (see portal for eligibility rules and payout method).


• How to promote us:

  • Gift guides: Birthdays, housewarming, thank-you gifts, autumn/winter gifting.
  • Home fragrance content: “Cosy night in”, self-care routines, seasonal home styling.
  • Short-form video: Unboxing, close-ups of botanicals, lighting the candle, burn progress.
  • Bundles and sets: Highlight gift sets and best-selling scents.
  • Seasonal moments: Autumn/Winter scents (e.g., Mulled Wine, Orange & Cinnamon) perform especially well.


• Other information:

  • We ship across the UK and internationally (where available at checkout).
  • We can provide product photos, key product details, and best-seller recommendations to help you create content.
  • Offline-friendly promotion support: we can provide personalised printed and PDF catalogues with QR codes that link to your personal affiliate product links.

We care about honest marketing: please avoid misleading claims and always represent the brand accurately.

Beauty Scents Candles — Affiliate Programme Terms & Conditions

Welcome to Beauty Scents Candles. Thanks for your interest in joining our Affiliate Programme.

These Terms & Conditions apply to individuals and entities who access or use the affiliate programme (the Programme) as an affiliate (“you”, “Affiliate”). They are issued by AJKORN TRADING LTD (trading as Beauty Scents Candles) (“we”, “us”, “our”, the “Merchant”).

Company details

•    Legal entity: AJKORN TRADING LTD (trading as Beauty Scents Candles)

•    Company number: 15915755

•    Registered / trading address: 39 Manccetter Square, Peterborough, PE4 6BX, United Kingdom

•    Phone: 01733711024

•    Email: sales@beautyscentscandles.co.uk

By registering for or participating in the Programme, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, you must not register or participate.

1. Approval or rejection of registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any application to the Programme at our sole discretion. If your application is rejected, you will have no legal recourse against us for that decision.

2. Affiliate status (self-employed / independent)

2.1 Independent contractor

Affiliates participate in the Programme as self-employed independent contractors. You are not an employee, worker, agent, partner, franchisee, or legal representative of AJKORN TRADING LTD.

2.2 What this means (tax and legal)

•    You are responsible for your own taxes: You must declare and pay any income tax, national insurance/social security, VAT/sales tax (if applicable), and any other taxes arising from commissions or other income you earn through the Programme.

•    No payroll deductions by us: We do not operate PAYE (or equivalent) or make payroll deductions on your behalf.

•    No employment benefits: You are not entitled to employee benefits (for example holiday pay, sick pay, pension contributions, redundancy pay, or minimum wage protections) from us.

•    Your own legal compliance: You are responsible for ensuring your marketing activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, and platform rules in your country (including advertising disclosures).

Nothing in these Terms creates an employment relationship. If you are unsure about your tax or legal obligations, you should seek independent professional advice.

3. Affiliate links, attribution and coupon codes

3.1 Affiliate links

•    Your affiliate link is generated automatically when you join the Programme.

•    You may also be able to generate affiliate links to specific products or collections via your affiliate dashboard.

3.2 Attribution model (last click)

Unless otherwise stated in your dashboard, the Programme uses last-click attribution. This means if a customer clicks another affiliate’s referral link and later clicks your referral link, your link will be the one that counts for tracking purposes.

3.3 Coupon codes

•    You may or may not be assigned a coupon code. If you are assigned a coupon code, the details and permitted usage will be shown in your affiliate dashboard.

•    If a customer clicks your affiliate link and also uses a coupon code, you will not receive double commission.

•    If you are not assigned a coupon code, you must not promote any coupon code as an “affiliate code” or imply you can offer a discount.

3.4 Permitted promotion channels

You may promote Beauty Scents Candles online (for example: your website, blog, email list where you have permission, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and similar channels) and offline (for example: printed materials, magazines, newspapers, classified ads), provided you comply with these Terms & Conditions and all applicable laws and platform rules.

4. Commission, cookie period and payment

4.1 Commission rate

Affiliates earn 15% commission on eligible tracked referral sales.

4.2 Cookie period

The cookie period is 30 days. Cookie tracking begins when a customer clicks your affiliate link (or uses your assigned coupon code, where applicable).

4.3 Commission calculation

•    Commission is calculated on the eligible order value excluding shipping, taxes, duties and other fees.

•    Commission is only earned on orders that are successfully completed and not cancelled.

4.4 Refunds, chargebacks and fraud

•    Orders that are refunded, cancelled, disputed, charged back, or identified as fraudulent are not eligible for commission.

•    We reserve the right to review and withhold commissions where we reasonably suspect abuse, fraud, policy breaches, or inaccurate/misleading promotion.

4.5 Payout schedule and payout method

•    Commission payouts are made weekly, subject to any minimum payout threshold or approval rules shown in your affiliate dashboard.

•    To receive payouts, you must provide accurate payment details in your affiliate dashboard.

•    Payout timing may be affected by bank processing times and verification checks.

5. Marketing assets and support

We may provide marketing materials (for example: banners, logos, product images, collection highlights and other creative assets) through the Programme’s marketing tools. You may use these materials solely to promote Beauty Scents Candles as part of the Programme.

We may also provide personalised printed and PDF catalogues that include QR codes linking to your personal affiliate product links. These materials are provided to support your promotion and must not be altered in a way that is misleading.

6. Cookie and tracking limitations

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to attribute sales to affiliates.

•    Customers must allow cookies for tracking to work.

•    If a customer blocks cookies, clears cookies, uses a different device/browser, or uses privacy tools that prevent tracking, we may be unable to attribute the sale to you and commission may not be payable.

7. Affiliate conduct and prohibited activities

You agree that you will:

•    Represent Beauty Scents Candles honestly and accurately.

•    Comply with all applicable laws, regulations, advertising standards and platform terms (including disclosure requirements such as “affiliate link” or “ad” where required).

You must not:

•    Make false, misleading or unsubstantiated claims about our products.

•    Use spam, unsolicited messages, or any deceptive marketing practices.

•    Impersonate Beauty Scents Candles, misrepresent your relationship with us, or create websites/social accounts that could confuse customers into thinking you are the official store.

•    Attempt to manipulate tracking, commissions, or orders (including self-referrals or placing orders primarily to generate commission).

We may suspend or terminate your account and withhold unpaid commissions if we reasonably believe you have breached this section.

8. Removal from the Programme / termination

8.1 Affiliate removal request

If you wish to be removed from the Programme, please contact: sales@beautyscentscandles.co.uk.

8.2 Our right to terminate

We may suspend or terminate your participation in the Programme at any time, with or without notice, if we believe you have breached these Terms & Conditions or if we discontinue the Programme.

9. Changes to these Terms

We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time. The latest version will be available in the affiliate portal and/or on request. Continued participation in the Programme after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

10. Questions

If you have any questions about the Programme, please email sales@beautyscentscandles.co.uk.

Go forward and refer — and thank you for supporting Beauty Scents Candles.
